decisions.reason: The one-PDF email submission constraint does not revoke or alter the independently required editable Canva source access.
The PDF export and submission constraints do not change which tables must be integrated or how they are treated.
The layout requirement remains valid unchanged; email-compatible PDF export is independently represented by the source Requirement.
The source does not specify any change to photo selection, integration, or treatment.
The candidate already captures the separate same-message section-order decision; the PDF export clause does not further change narrative integration.
The email-compatible PDF decision does not change the selected Agua Arc identity or brand assets.
Specifying email as the submission method does not alter any current deadline, turnaround, or delivery-window attribute.
The source decision concerns the separate GreenLatinos RFQ and does not affect the TPEC proposal.
The source does not change the agreed number of revision rounds.
The file-count, email-submission, and export-quality constraints do not change the anticipated page count.
